prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["How to Control & Summon Your Pet", "Right-click your pet anytime to access controls, minimize to system tray, or chat.", "Right-click for options menu | Drag to move across monitors | Double-click to play"]
1: ["Upload Your Pet Photo", "Upload a clear, well-lit photo for best 3D pet generation results.", "Choose Photo"]
2: ["Sign In & Sync Your Pets", "Sign in to recover existing pets or save your new desktop companion safely to the cloud.", "Cloud Account Pet Sync", "Existing pets automatically restored"]
3: ["Tips while your pet prepares...", "Estimated completion time"]
4: ["Select Your Pet Path", "Adopt a ready companion or generate a unique custom desktop pet.", "Quick Adopt vs Custom Create"]
5: ["Verified 3D desktop rendering setup ready. Your pet specs are saved safely.", "100% Cloud Saved & Multi-Monitor Ready"]
6: ["Desktop Visibility Check", "Can you see your pet floating on your desktop screen right now?", "Yes, I see my pet!", "Troubleshoot Display"]
7: ["Welcome Home! Starter Pack Unlocked", "Your desktop pet is ready. You have received 3 free starter toy items!", "Bonus Starter Toys Unlocked"]
8: ["Meet Your New Floating Desktop Companion", "Choose a pre-made pet or turn your own photo into a live desktop buddy in seconds."]
9: ["Signing in automatically restores all your previously adopted pets and accessories."]

verdicts.problem: Mentions free extras and bonus items
